blocks.heading: Policy Commentary From the Observer Research

items.text: A policy commentary from the Observer Research Foundation says the animation, visual effects, gaming and comics (AVGC) sector employs roughly 2.6 lakh professionals.

blocks.sourceSectionTitle: What the data shows, and what it does not
supporting: A policy commentary from the Observer Research Foundation says the animation, visual effects, gaming and comics (AVGC) sector employs roughly 2.6 lakh professionals. It cites the government task force estimate of close to 2 million skilled professionals needed by 2030 and over 23 lakh direct and indirect jobs by 2032.

All Media and Entertainment sector figures on the government broadcaster's site are projections: the sector is expected to cross 100 billion US dollars by 2030, and the task force expects about 2 million jobs over ten years. Animation and VFX services are described as having a 40 to 60 percent cost advantage, which is why foreign studios outsource to India.

Strong
